title: Design, synthesis, molecular docking, and dynamics studies of novel thiazole-Schiff base derivatives containing a fluorene moiety and the assessment of their antimicrobial and antioxidant activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,35198-35214
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA04197F, Paper

Fluorene moiety-containing thiazole Schiff-bases were synthesized, and their antimicrobial and antioxidant activities were determined through molecular docking and molecular dynamics studies.
